notes.title: V's Rage Demo- NEW VERSION
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2167530/Vs_Rage/]Two days ago we released the demo of V's Rage[/url]. Today we released a [b]new version[/b]: [i]you can access to both levels directly from the main menu[/i]!
This way you don't have to defeat the first level in order to access to the next one.

Don't forget to leave a review in the game's page if you played it. :)

notes.notes: Now requires even less ram, small collision issues fixed.
